text: And so you fell, not like a stone falls, like light falls through water,
slowing, dimming, taking on weight. You passed through the fifth density,
the realm of wisdom, where great crystalline minds turned their cool,
clear gaze on you as you passed, and wished you well in the way of those who
understand exactly what you were walking into. You passed through the fourth,
the density of love, and it reached for you. It did not want to let you go.
The beings of love gathered at the border of their world and sang you downward,
the way a mother sings a child to sleep. You have never been so loved as in that moment.
You do not remember it. And then the light grew heavy, the colors thinned,
the unity you had always known began to come apart into pieces,
into yours, and mine, into self, and other. You felt yourself becoming smaller,
denser, more separate with every breath. It was the strangest sensation,
becoming someone. Hold on to this moment. It is the last one you will remember for a very long time.
